title: pvTessellate
body:
## pvTessellate

Subdivides cells with non-linear geometry or fields (quadratic and higher-order cells) into linear simplices (tetrahedra, triangles or lines up to OutputDimension) until the chord error and optional per-field errors at edge midpoints fall below their limits, giving an unstructured grid that approximates curved geometry and fields with linear pieces. Use it before operations or exports that only handle linear cells; linear input is just split into simplices.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Output size grows quickly with MaximumNumberofSubdivisions, especially with OutputDimension 3.
- ChordError is in dataset length units; tighten it for small parts.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Tessellate`. Identity: `filters/TessellatorFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Tessellate filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData); any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData","vtkDataSet","vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ChordError` | This property controls the maximum chord error allowed at any edge midpoint in the output tessellation. The chord error is measured as the distance between the midpoint of any output edge and the original nonlinear geometry. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FieldError` | This property controls the maximum field error allowed at any edge midpoint in the output tessellation. The field error is measured as the difference between a field value at the midpoint of an output edge and the value of the corresponding field in the original nonlinear geometry. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `MaximumNumberofSubdivisions` | This property specifies the maximum number of times an edge may be subdivided. Increasing this number allows further refinement but can drastically increase the computational and storage requirements, especially when the value of the OutputDimension property is 3. | `{"maximum":8,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `MergePoints` | If the value of this property is set to 1, coincident vertices will be merged after tessellation has occurred. Only geometry is considered during the merge and the first vertex encountered is the one whose point attributes will be used. Any discontinuities in point fields will be lost. On the other hand, many operations, such as streamline generation, require coincident vertices to be merged. Toggle whether to merge coincident vertices. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `OutputDimension` | The value of this property sets the maximum dimensionality of the output tessellation. When the value of this property is 3, 3D cells produce tetrahedra, 2D cells produce triangles, and 1D cells produce line segments. When the value is 2, 3D cells will have their boundaries tessellated with triangles. When the value is 1, all cells except points produce line segments. | `{"maximum":3,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

onVisit commands:

```json
{
  "ResetFieldCriteria": {
    "command": "ResetFieldCriteria",
    "native": "ResetFieldCriteria"
  }
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTessellate",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["ResetFieldCriteria"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
